Why GPL-3.0
-----------
The SKSE plugin (BodyInflationNG.dll) is built on CommonLibSSE-NG
(https://github.com/alandtse/CommonLibSSE-NG), which is GPL-3.0 licensed, so
SLIF NG is distributed under the same terms. The complete corresponding source
- C++ and Papyrus - is in the GitHub repository linked above; the Papyrus
sources also ship in this download under Data\source\scripts.

Credits
-------
SLIF NG is a reimplementation of SexLab Inflation Framework by qotsafan: the
API, the node vocabulary and the calculation formulas are theirs, kept intact
so the mods built on SLIF keep working. See the Credits section of the mod
page and the repository README for the full list.
